topic: Harry Harlow (1958) Wire Milk Surrogate vs Soft Terrycloth Contact Comfort (17 Hours vs 1 Hour), Drumming Toy Safe-Haven Sprint, Open-Field Secure Base Exploration, Ethics Reform, and Kangaroo Care (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Integration of Harlow's contact-comfort findings with John Bowlby's Attachment Theory transforming sterile neonatal nurseries into warm skin-to-skin newborn care alongside institutional animal-welfare reforms.
